Thought destroyer corpse-spawn timing and probability are not implemented here; the preserved static/directed-drop fallback is intentional and protected by existing tests. Wiki post-Hate-revamp language and weighted25% breastplate pool differ from the fallback and mandatory Destroyer drop.

Nella spawn x178.5/y708.9 differs from wiki x115/y675-677; existing Z/heading and engine zero-HP scaling are preserved. Actual spawn placement, navigation and access have not been observed. Actor HP/class details also differ in places: no broad combat/stat rebalance is claimed.

Irak's periodic wandering emote and Jark's second mining emote are not timed in their current scripts; no cadence is documented. Nella and peasant hails use existing discovery emotes despite no P99 hail reply. Irak does not depop after reward; the narrative alone does not establish a required timed disappearance.

Multiquest across players or stored partial offers is not proven; current items helper requires the complete matching offer and returns unmatched items in the mock. Independent fresh offers are tested, not cross-player persistence.

Precursor dragon-book drops, optional Ghoulbane component/camping acquisition, merchant ingredients, escort/pathing, non-Paladin SoulFire charges, recipe failures and all predecessor open limits remain unresolved. Reused source records are not whole-chain completion.

The cached main page has no exact numerical Joshua XP, most reward XP/factions, NPC spawn probabilities, or item-template combat values. Retained fallback values must not be described as P99-established.
